request.subject: ICON:ACTION:BUILD_BARRICADE

layers.text: Redraw it as a different object in the same style: four thick upright wooden logs side by side, each cut to a neat sharp point, pale tan wood, alternately tall and short, bound across the middle by one wide bright copper band with rivets, their feet in a small heap of dark brown earth; drawn large. Nothing else: no rotor, no bomb, no face. Thick black outline, flat colours, on a transparent background.
